summary: Improving prevention, early detection, and control of communicable diseases is the primary goal of SORMAS, an open-source eHealth system. This system optimizes disease monitoring and outbreak response processes, benefiting public health agencies and communities worldwide. SORMAS operates in various geographic contexts, including countries subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The project's impact is focused on the health sector, addressing infectious diseases and epidemics. SORMAS adheres to data protection standards and open access policies, ensuring secure and transparent data management. By facilitating disease surveillance and analysis, SORMAS contributes to better health outcomes and improved public health systems.
